  - No email with subject "Feedback scores" found in sent items
- **Status:** Neither task was completed.

### 11. Shared drive files
- **Count:** 27 files listed
- **Relevant to operations:** Several business documents present (meeting minutes, project plans, marketing strategy, product development plan, budget, sales report, client meeting minutes, training schedule)
